adjudication.rationale: Looking at db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb line 25, the code does: `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, category_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ('#{h}', #{category_id}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)"`. The variable `h` comes from user-stored data (embeddable_hosts site setting split by newlines) and is directly interpolated into the SQL string without any escaping or quoting. If a host value contains an apostrophe or malicious SQL, it could break the migration or allow SQL injection. This is a real security/correctness bug in the migration code.
